item.title: Live your values, and adopt values to live by
item.description: Participate in public institutions — and support them
item.dc:creator: Matthew Yglesias
item.content:encoded:
Something we like to do on federal holidays is bring an older article out from behind the paywall.

Public schools, public parks and public libraries work best when the people who can afford to leave them choose to stay, and when they stay they make them better for everyone else.

Values to live by

That is a simple idea and a hard practice. It asks parents to put their own children into institutions they could opt out of, and to argue for those institutions in public.
